intro: Fifteen healthcare articles published between 12 April and 10 October 2026 examine a sector under sustained pressure, with LockBit, Booba, and Interlock among the most-covered threat actors. The reporting spans healthcare, critical infrastructure, education, and financial services, and reaches readers across the United States, Texas, and California, alongside global and North American coverage. Eleven items carry high severity and one medium, reflecting a period in which healthcare organisations and the critical infrastructure around them absorbed repeated attention from the three named groups.
